# KUUS DISAIN

> KUUS DISAIN (English: KUUS DESIGN) is a premium microcement studio in Tartu, Estonia, and the official LUXURY CONCRETE® reseller in Estonia. We supply and install handcrafted Luxury Concrete® mineral surfaces for luxury residential and commercial interiors — seamless floors, waterproof bathrooms, and decorative walls.

## What we do
- Luxury Concrete® microcement flooring — seamless, over existing tiles, underfloor-heating compatible
- Luxury Concrete® microcement bathrooms — waterproof, zero-demolition renovation
- Luxury Concrete® microcement walls and feature surfaces
- Metallic wall finishes — Oxid Metal, True Metal, Colorcrete Metal
- Limecrete lime-based tadelakt surfaces — vapour-permeable, natural
- Mineral furniture and custom objects
- Professional microcement installation training and certification

## Product range (Luxury Concrete®, Spanish manufacturer)
- [Concrete](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/concrete): two-component system for floors, walls, outdoor, pools
- [Monocrete](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/monocrete): one-component system (Base, Wall, Floor)
- [Easycret](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/easycret): ready-to-use paste (Thin, Basic, Medium)
- [Concrete Pox](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/concrete-pox): epoxy system, high abrasion resistance
- [Limecrete](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/limecrete): lime-based tadelakt system
- [Metallic](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/metallic): Colorcrete Metal, Oxid Metal, True Metal
- [Primers](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/primers), [Sealers](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/sealers), [Pigments](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/pigments), [Care](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/care), [Tools](https://www.kuusdisain.ee/et/products/tools)

## Service area
Tartu, Estonia — serving all of Estonia and the wider Baltic region (Latvia, Lithuania) and the EU.

## Brand
Established 2024. Philosophy: quiet luxury through material honesty. Every surface is hand-troweled by certified applicators using professional Luxury Concrete® microcement systems. KUUS DISAIN is the official LUXURY CONCRETE® reseller in Estonia.
